Easiest on one burner: creamy chicken and mushroom orzo, about 25 minutes.

- Soften 250 g sliced cremini and an onion, add 1 cup orzo and 3 cups stock.

- Finish with chopped fresh cilantro or parsley.

p50 vs p95 again, quick

p50 is the median: half of payouts are faster than it. p95 is the value 95% are faster than, so it shows the slow tail. A good p50 with a bad p95 means most merchants are fine but a few wait a long time.
